w2-c07.program:
app "Fuel gauge" bolt ocean
setting budget money = 50000 "Monthly budget"
table spend amount money, note text
let used = sum(spend.amount month)
let left = budget - used
let frac = clamp(left / budget, 0, 1)
draw 100, 60 width 240 middle
  arc 50, 55, 40, 270, 450 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 50, 55, 40, 270, 270 + 180 * frac stroke accent thick 8
  line 50, 55, 50 + 34 * sin(-90 + 180 * frac), 55 - 34 * cos(-90 + 180 * frac) stroke ink thick 2
  label 50, 50, left big
stat used, "burned this month"
"Remaining of" budget faint align center
form spend, "Add spend"
list spend by day

w2-c08.program:
app "Carrom" game ink
table point team pick A|B|C, n num 1..9 = 1
table board
let sa = sum(point.n where team = A)
let sb = sum(point.n where team = B)
let sc = sum(point.n where team = C)
row gap 2
  stack align center grow
    "Team A" bold
    sa huge
    row gap 1
      button "+1" tap add point team = A, n = 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = A, n = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = A, n = 3
  stack align center grow
    "Team B" bold
    sb huge
    row gap 1
      button "+1" tap add point team = B, n = 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = B, n = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = B, n = 3
  stack align center grow
    "Team C" bold
    sc huge
    row gap 1
      button "+1" tap add point team = C, n = 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = C, n = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = C, n = 3
"Boards played:" count(board) big
row gap 1
  button "Undo last point" tap remove last(point)
  button "New board" tap add board then remove all point
  button "Reset everything" tap remove all point then remove all board

w2-u02.program:
app "Volleyball" ball ocean
table rally side pick Home|Away, set num 1..5
state cur num = 1 keep
let hs(s num) = count(rally where set = s and side = Home)
let as_(s num) = count(rally where set = s and side = Away)
let won(a num, b num) = a >= 25 and a - b >= 2
let home = hs(cur)
let away = as_(cur)
let over = won(home, away) or won(away, home)
row gap 2
  stack align center grow
    "Home" bold
    home huge
    count(1..5, won(hs(it), as_(it))) "sets" faint
    button "+1" tap add rally side = Home, set = cur
  stack align center grow
    "Away" bold
    away huge
    count(1..5, won(as_(it), hs(it))) "sets" faint
    button "+1" tap add rally side = Away, set = cur
"Set" cur "of 5" faint
if over
  "Set won" bold color good
  button "Next set" tap set cur = min(cur + 1, 5)
button "Reset match" tap remove all rally then set cur = 1

w2-u07.program:
app "Quiz" brain ocean
table answer q num 1..5, ok bool
state qi num = 1
let ques(n num) = if(n = 1, "Capital of Pakistan?", if(n = 2, "How many continents are there?", if(n = 3, "Largest planet?", if(n = 4, "Boiling point of water in C?", "Fastest land animal?"))))
let oa(n num) = if(n = 1, "Karachi", if(n = 2, "7", if(n = 3, "Mars", if(n = 4, "90", "Lion"))))
let ob(n num) = if(n = 1, "Islamabad", if(n = 2, "5", if(n = 3, "Jupiter", if(n = 4, "120", "Cheetah"))))
let oc(n num) = if(n = 1, "Lahore", if(n = 2, "6", if(n = 3, "Saturn", if(n = 4, "100", "Horse"))))
let right(n num) = if(n = 1, 2, if(n = 2, 1, if(n = 3, 2, if(n = 4, 3, 2))))
let answered = count(answer where q = qi) > 0
if qi > 5
  stat count(answer where ok = yes), "score out of 5"
  button "Restart" tap remove all answer then set qi = 1
else
  "Question" qi "of 5" faint
  text ques(qi) head
  button oa(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 1
  button ob(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 2
  button oc(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 3
  if answered
    if(last(answer.ok), "Correct", "Wrong") bold color if(last(answer.ok), good, bad)
    button "Next" tap set qi = qi + 1
